BiblicalUsage: Pitstsets — Aphses in the English — was a priest, chief of the eighteenth course in David's temple service. He is named once, in 1 Chronicles 24:15: the seventeenth lot fell to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God ordered the temple service lot by lot, and the eighteenth course mattered as much as the first.
